name: LAFU Category Admin Enhancer for WooCommerce
author: elsama101

sections.description:
A simple UI enhancement for the Product Categories meta box in WooCommerce.

This plugin improves category selection on the product edit screen by adding live search, automatic parent category selection, and clearer visibility of selected categories.

It works entirely in the WordPress admin area and does not affect the frontend of your store.

What It Does

LAFU Category Admin Enhancer for WooCommerce improves the Product Categories UI inside the product edit page.

It adds:

  • Live category search for faster selection
  • Automatic parent category selection when choosing a child
  • Clear display of selected categories
  • Optional enable or disable control from settings

Designed for stores with large category structures where scrolling becomes slow and inefficient.

Why Use It

Managing product categories in large WooCommerce stores can be time-consuming.

This plugin provides a simple UI improvement that makes category selection faster and clearer, without changing how your store works on the frontend.

Scope

  • Admin area only
  • No frontend changes
  • No WooCommerce core modifications
  • Lightweight and focused
sections.installation:
Install via the WordPress Plugin Directory or upload manually through the Plugins screen in WordPress.

Activate the plugin and edit a product to see the enhanced Product Categories meta box.

Optional: Configure options under Products → LAFU Category Enhancer.
sections.faq:
Does this affect the frontend category pages?

No. This plugin only enhances the admin product edit screen.

Does it modify WooCommerce core files?

No. It uses standard WordPress hooks and does not modify core files.

Will it work with large category structures?

Yes. It is designed to improve usability in stores with many categories.
